title: HealthLens: An Integrated East-West Steady-State Axis Framework for Non-Pharmacological Cellular Repair Guidance
title_zh: HealthLens：中西结合、古今结合的稳态轴框架——面向非药物细胞修复指导的理论体系
abstract_excerpt: We propose a falsifiable, measurement-first framework that maps classical Chinese medicine constructs (qi-blood, zang-fu, yin-yang, zheng-xie) onto eight measurable steady-state biology axes (autophagy/AMPK-mTOR, mitochondrial biogenesis/PGC-1alpha-SIRT1, senescence clearance/senolytics, circadian CLOCK-BMAL1, neuroendocrine, inflammation, affect/HRV-EEG, epigenetic clock). A gene-pathway x classical-candidate intersection rule generates personalized, evidence-graded non-drug recommendations. A stratified case evidence base (n=120) discloses each entry by verification status: 7 Crossref-verified human-trial or classical-experience entries (e.g., 4-week fasting LAMP2 up 4.2x; D+Q frailty 400m gait p=0.0001; early-TRE hepatic fat -23.7%), 8 traditional-text entries, 14 unverified_no_publication entries, and 91 synthetic_validation entries kept as a separate S class and not counted toward L1-L3 grades. An in-silico computational validation of the fusion engine (22 synthetic profiles) demonstrates 100% reproducibility, 100% coverage of weak-node profiles, 75% L1-grade coverage under the evidence gate, 88% domain-expectation concordance with an author-encoded TCM keyword dictionary used only as an exploratory content-validity proxy, and 0 personalized output for control profiles. All 1754 automated tests pass. The Sense-Infer-Intervene-Verify loop closes via wearable/CGM/BCI ingest. This positions traditional experience as falsifiable hypothesis rather than mechanism, preserving a publishable scientific base.
